en.title: The Golden Sand Mail Ship and Memories of Azure Wings
en.premise: A young mail carrier traversing the vast deserts happens upon a letter that lost its destination decades ago. Within its pages lies a guide to a legendary city where the waters never run dry—a place absent from every known map. Alongside a migratory bird as his guide, he sets sail across the silent sea of sand aboard a rusted steamship. Thus begins a journey to uncover lost promises and the hidden secrets of the world.

zh.title: 黄金砂的邮船与碧翼之记忆
zh.premise: 一名在沙漠中穿行的年轻邮递员，偶然捡到了一封在数十年前便失去地址的信件。信中记载的，是前往地图上不存在的“水源不竭的传说之都”的指引。他与作为引导者的候鸟同行，驾驶着锈迹斑斑的蒸汽船，向着静谧的沙海启航。这是一场追寻失落约定，揭开世界秘密的旅程。
